" alt="柄と鍔を付けた村正の再現素材"><svg id="bladeSpiral" viewBox="0 0 200 500" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path pathLength="100" d="M100 0C300 40-100 100 100 150S300 220 100 280S-100 350 100 410S260 470 100 500"/></svg></div><div id="bladeRipples" aria-hidden="true"></div><div id="bladeFooter">N E X U S</div>`;
app.append(content);
document.getElementById('bladeVoice').append(document.getElementById('recordingBtn'));
const panel=document.createElement('div');panel.id='bladeSystem';panel.innerHTML=`<h2>✿ NEXUS // SYSTEM</h2><dl><div><dt>STATUS</dt><dd id="bladeStatus">未確認</dd></div><div><dt>CORE</dt><dd>NEXUS v181</dd></div><div><dt>MODE</dt><dd>BROWSER EXPERIMENT</dd></div></dl><h2 class="section">◇ TASKS // ACTIVE</h2><div id="bladeTasks"><span data-stage="think">聞き取り・解析</span><span data-stage="plan">道具・結果の確認</span><span data-stage="create">応答の作成</span><span data-stage="execute">道具の実行</span></div><div id="bladeNow"></div><h2 class="section">◯ AI // LINK</h2><dl><div><dt>GEMINI</dt><dd id="bladeGemini">未確認</dd></div><div><dt>GROQ</dt><dd id="bladeGroq">未確認</dd></div></dl><button id="bladeSettings" type="button">AI 設定</button>`;
document.getElementById('taskPanel').append(panel);
document.getElementById('bladeSettings').onclick=()=>window.NexusAI?.open();
const send=document.createElement('button');send.id='bladeSend';send.type='button';send.title='送信';send.setAttribute('aria-label','送信');send.textContent='➤';document.querySelector('.composer').append(send);
send.onclick=()=>{const input=document.getElementById('typingStatus');input.focus();input.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',code:'Enter',bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));};
// 接続済み設定だけではONLINEにしない。既存通信のHTTP応答のみ観察する。
const observed={gemini:null,groq:null};
try{new PerformanceObserver(list=>{for(const e of list.getEntries()){let u;try{u=new URL(e.name);}catch{continue;}const p=u.hostname==='generativelanguage.googleapis.com'?'gemini':u.hostname==='api.groq.com'?'groq':null;if(p&&e.responseStatus)observed[p]={ok:e.responseStatus>=200&&e.responseStatus<300,at:Date.now(),status:e.responseStatus};}render();}).observe({type:'resource',buffered:true});}catch{}
window.addEventListener('nexus-ai-changed',()=>{observed.gemini=null;observed.groq=null;render();});
function render(){
 const p=document.getElementById('taskPanel'),state=p.dataset.state,status=document.getElementById('taskStatus').textContent;
 const speaking=document.getElementById('holo').classList.contains('speaking');
 let stage='';if(/ACTION|操作/.test(status)&&['thinking','speaking'].includes(state))stage='execute';else if(state==='listening')stage='think';else if(state==='thinking')stage=/結果/.test(document.getElementById('taskCurrent').textContent)?'plan':'think';else if(state==='speaking')stage='create';
 document.querySelectorAll('#bladeTitle [data-stage],#bladeTasks [data-stage]').forEach(e=>e.dataset.active=String(e.dataset.stage===stage));
 const center=document.getElementById('bladeCenter');center.dataset.speaking=String(speaking);center.dataset.thinking=String(state==='thinking');
 document.getElementById('bladeNow').textContent=document.getElementById('taskCurrent').textContent;
 let online=false;for(const name of ['gemini','groq']){const e=observed[name],fresh=e&&Date.now()-e.at<60000;let text=fresh?(e.ok?'HTTP '+e.status+' 確認':'HTTP '+e.status+' エラー'):'未確認';if(name==='gemini'&&status==='LIVE'&&speaking){text='LIVE 応答中';online=true;}if(fresh&&e.ok)online=true;document.getElementById(name==='gemini'?'bladeGemini':'bladeGroq').textContent=text;}
 const overall=online?'応答確認':window.NexusAI?.enabled()?'接続未確認':'未接続';document.getElementById('bladeStatus').textContent=overall;document.getElementById('bladeOnline').textContent=overall;
}
new MutationObserver(render).observe(document.getElementById('taskPanel'),{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['data-state']});
new MutationObserver(render).observe(document.getElementById('taskCurrent'),{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});
new MutationObserver(render).observe(document.getElementById('holo'),{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});
setInterval(render,1000);render();
})();
</script>

<style>
.nexus-motion {
  --accent: #7dcfff;
  --duration: 9s;
  --strength: .34;
  position: absolute;
  pointer-events: none;
  inset: 0;
}
#bladeCenter .nexus-motion {
  inset: 4% auto 10%;
  left: 50%;
  width: min(40vw, 50vh);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}
#monoCenter .nexus-motion { --accent: #9eeaff; }
#awCenter .nexus-motion { --accent: #baff73; }
.nexus-motion[data-phase="listening"] { --duration: 3.6s; --strength: .68; }
.nexus-motion[data-phase="thinking"] { --duration: 2.6s; --strength: .57; }
.nexus-motion[data-phase="responding"] { --duration: 2s; --strength: .72; }
.nexus-motion[data-phase="speaking"] { --duration: 1.65s; --strength: .92; }

.nexus-motion::before, .nexus-motion::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  pointer-events: none;
}
#bladeCenter .nexus-motion::before {
  inset: 14% 42% 17%;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse, #b8eaff80, transparent 70%);
  animation: nexus-breathe var(--duration) ease-in-out infinite;
}
#bladeCenter .nexus-motion::after {
  inset: 16% 26%;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-top-color: var(--accent);
  border-bottom-color: #b7e8ff86;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: nexus-blade-current var(--duration) linear infinite;
}
#monoCenter .nexus-motion::before {
  inset: 15% 16% 21%;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid #9eeaff44;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 22px #5ab8ef55, 0 0 22px #5ab8ef55;
  animation: nexus-breathe var(--duration) ease-in-out infinite;
}
#monoCenter .nexus-motion::after {
  inset: 12% 9% auto;
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent), transparent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent);
  animation: nexus-stone-scan var(--duration) linear infinite;
}
#awCenter .nexus-motion::before {
  inset: 15% 23%;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse, #baff7350, transparent 70%);
  animation: nexus-breathe var(--duration) ease-in-out infinite;
}
#awCenter .nexus-motion::after {
  inset: auto 16% 25%;
  height: 18%;
  border: 1px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 17px #baff7366;
  animation: nexus-core-wave var(--duration) ease-out infinite;
}

@keyframes nexus-breathe {
  0%, 100% { opacity: calc(var(--strength) * .42); transform: scale(.95); }
  50% { opacity: var(--strength); transform: scale(1.05); }
}
@keyframes nexus-blade-current {
  0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(18%) rotate(-24deg) scale(.68, .13); }
  25%, 70% { opacity: var(--strength); }
  100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-41%) rotate(24deg) scale(1.07, .23); }
}
@keyframes nexus-stone-scan {
  0% { top: 12%; opacity: 0; }
  17%, 79% { opacity: var(--strength); }
  100% { top: 77%; opacity: 0; }
}
@keyframes nexus-core-wave {
  0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(50%) scale(.66); }
  25%, 60% { opacity: var(--strength); }
  100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-215%) scale(1.13); }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .nexus-motion.nexus-motion::before, .nexus-motion.nexus-motion::after {
    animation: none !important;
    opacity: var(--strength);
  }
}
.nexus-mobile-controls { display: none; }
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  #bladeHeader, #monoHeader, #awHeader { height: 50px; min-height: 50px; gap: 5px; letter-spacing: 0; }
  #bladeHeader strong, #monoHeader strong, #awHeader strong { font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: .09em; }
  #bladeHeader small, #monoHeader small, #awHeader small, #awHeader em,
  #bladeTitle, #bladeFooter, #monoTitle, #monoRecords, #monoRail,
  #awLeft, #awStrip, #awButtons, #awBanner { display: none; }
  #bladeCenter, #monoCenter, #awCenter {
    top: 59px;
    height: min(56vh, 510px);
    height: min(56dvh, 510px);
  }
  #bladeSword {
    left: calc(-1 * min(56vh, 510px) * .4 * .29);
    left: calc(-1 * min(56dvh, 510px) * .4 * .29);
  }
  #monoCenter, #awCenter { width: min(86vw, 430px); }
  #bladeCenter .nexus-motion { width: 53vw; }
  #taskPanel {
    inset: 57px 10px auto auto !important;
    width: min(90vw, 360px) !important;
    height: auto !important;
    max-height: 60vh !important;
    z-index: 24 !important;
  }
  #taskPanel:not([data-mobile-open="true"]) { display: none !important; }
  .nexus-mobile-controls {
    display: flex;
    gap: 6px;
    position: fixed;
    top: 56px;

    z-index: 26;
  }
  .nexus-mobile-controls button {
    min-height: 32px;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    color: #f2f7ff;
    background: #0c1524;
    border: 1px solid #90acc5;
    border-radius: 7px;
  }
  #taskPanel[data-mobile-open="true"] { top: 91px !important; }
  body .console, body .input-area {
    left: 10px !important;
    right: 10px !important;
    top: auto !important;
    width: auto !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
  }
  body .console {
    bottom: calc(65px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) !important;
    height: 78px !important;
  }
  body .input-area {
    bottom: calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) !important;
    height: 50px !important;
  }
  body .input-area .composer { height: 48px !important; min-height: 0 !important; padding-block: 0 !important; }
  body .input-area #typingStatus { min-width: 0 !important; height: 44px !important; max-height: 44px !important; padding-block: 8px !important; box-sizing: border-box !important; font-size: 16px !important; }
  .input-area button { min-height: 42px; }
}

</style>
<script>
(() => {
  const center = document.querySelector('#bladeCenter, #monoCenter, #awCenter');
  const panel = document.getElementById('taskPanel');
  const holo = document.getElementById('holo');
  const status = document.getElementById('taskStatus');
  if (!center || !panel || !holo || !status) return;

  const motion = document.createElement('div');
  motion.className = 'nexus-motion';
  motion.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  center.append(motion);

  function updateMotion() {
    const state = panel.dataset.state;
    const route = status.textContent.trim();
    let phase = 'idle';
    if (holo.classList.contains('speaking')) {
      phase = 'speaking';
    } else if (state === 'listening' || (state === 'thinking' && /^(LIVE|MIC)$/.test(route))) {
      phase = 'listening';
    } else if (state === 'thinking') {
      phase = 'thinking';
    } else if (state === 'speaking') {
      phase = 'responding';
    }
    if (motion.dataset.phase !== phase) motion.dataset.phase = phase;
  }

  const observer = new MutationObserver(updateMotion);
  observer.observe(panel, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-state'] });
  observer.observe(holo, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
  observer.observe(status, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });
  updateMotion();

  const statusToggle = document.createElement('button');
  statusToggle.type = 'button';
  statusToggle.textContent = '状態';
  statusToggle.setAttribute('aria-controls', panel.id);
  statusToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  statusToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const open = panel.dataset.mobileOpen !== 'true';
    panel.dataset.mobileOpen = String(open);
    statusToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
  });
  const controls = document.createElement('div');
  controls.className = 'nexus-mobile-controls';
  controls.append(statusToggle);
  for (const [id, label] of [['monoArchiveOpen', '記録'], ['monoSettings', '設定'], ['awSettings', '設定']]) {
    const original = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!original) continue;
    const button = document.createElement('button');
    button.type = 'button';
    button.textContent = label;
    button.addEventListener('click', () => original.click());
    controls.append(button);
  }
  document.querySelector('#bladeHeader, #monoHeader, #awHeader').append(controls);
})();

</script>

<script>
(() => {
  const sword = document.getElementById('bladeSword');
  const center = document.getElementById('bladeCenter');
  const light = document.createElement('div');
  light.className = 'muramasa-blade-light';
  light.style.setProperty('--muramasa-sprite', 'url("' + sword.src + '")');
  sword.after(light);

  const measure = () => {
    light.style.setProperty('--muramasa-width', sword.getBoundingClientRect().width + 'px');
  };
  new ResizeObserver(measure).observe(sword);
  measure();

  const name = document.createElement('span');
  name.className = 'muramasa-mobile-name';
  name.textContent = '村正';
  document.querySelector('#bladeHeader strong').after(name);
})();
</script>
<!-- 16世紀の村正銘の刀を参考にした再現素材。柄と鍔はこの着せ替え用の意匠。

<script>
(() => {

  ornament.style.setProperty('--tassel-anchor', '5%');

  ornament.src = 'data:image/png;base64,
